title: Suit Warehouse
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight and Jim devise a scheme to impersonate family members to secure a paper supply contract for Stone & Son Suit Warehouse, with Dwight recruiting Clark to pose as his son. Meanwhile, Darryl prepares for and impresses in an interview at Jim's startup in Philadelphia, supported by Pam despite mixed feelings. The office engages in a coffee espresso taste test, and tensions arise during the sales pitch with the suit store family. The employees also move the copier into the annex, revealing hardwood floors beneath torn carpet. The episode ends with humorous office banter, a traffic jam in the parking lot, and a mysterious incident involving pens that results in carpet damage.
